core: Endothelin signalling in enteric and vascular development
qualifier: endothelin receptor control of arteries and blood pressure
name: Endothelin signalling in enteric nervous system and arteries
rationale: Members centre on endothelin receptor signalling driving enteric neural crest/gut development and arterial morphogenesis and pressure, which separates it from the RET/GDNF, gastrointestinal smooth muscle and catecholamine confusables.

name: Early metanephric development via mesenchyme-to-epithelium conversion
rationale: All members concern early metanephros formation (mesenchyme maintenance and differentiation, renal vesicle, tubule epithelium, ureteric bud/nephric duct), unlike confusables about later nephron segment morphogenesis, kidney size restraint or ureteric bud induction.

core: Transcriptional control of triglyceride and glucose homeostasis
name: Triglyceride and gluconeogenesis regulation by LXR and SREBP
rationale: Members regulate lipogenesis, triglyceride synthesis/lipolysis and gluconeogenesis, with LXR (NR1H2/3) and SREBP gene programs distinguishing it from the PPARA, circadian, glucagon-PKA and adipogenesis confusables.

name: EGFR and ERBB2 downstream adaptor signalling
rationale: Members are EGFR- and ERBB2-specific adaptor/effector events (GRB2, SHC1, PLCG1, PI3K, GRB7, GAB1, PTK6), whereas confusables are ERBB3/ERBB4-centred.

core: Axon growth and regeneration with glial myelination
qualifier: collateral sprouting and injury regeneration plus myelin formation
name: Axon regeneration, collateral sprouting and glial myelination
rationale: Members combine axon growth/regeneration and sprouting with myelination and glial responses, distinguishing it from Sema3A guidance confusables (no myelin) and node or glial-fate confusables (no regeneration).

name: Basement membrane matrix of skeletal muscle and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members are laminin/collagen basement membrane assembly and receptor interactions, and the muscle differentiation, dystrophin complex and NMJ assembly members distinguish it from collagen-fibril and hemidesmosome confusables.

name: E2F-driven G1/S transition and replication origin licensing
rationale: Members are E2F target transcription, proliferating T-cell cycle modules and ORC/CDC6/MCM pre-replicative complex assembly, distinguishing it from DNA damage, DREAM-repression and G2/M confusables.

qualifier: AMP, IMP and inosine degradation rather than salvage
name: Catabolism of AMP, IMP and inosine
rationale: All members describe breakdown of purine ribonucleotides and ribonucleosides, unlike confusables about purine salvage or deoxyribonucleoside catabolism.

name: tRNA guanine-N7 methylation
rationale: Members concern tRNA methylation, specifically guanine-N7, distinguishing it from mitochondrial tRNA modification, pseudouridylation and aminoacylation confusables.

qualifier: oligosaccharide precursor assembly and processing defects
name: Congenital N-glycosylation disorders of oligosaccharide assembly and processing
rationale: All members are CDG diseases from defects in lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly (ALG, DPAGT1, RFT1) or N-glycan processing, whereas confusables centre on DPM/GDP-mannose supply and GPI anchoring.

qualifier: L1-family and NCAM at nodes of Ranvier
name: L1-family and NCAM adhesion organizing nodes of Ranvier
rationale: Members are L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin and NCAM1 interactions together with sodium-channel clustering and paranodal assembly, distinguishing it from myelin, gap-junction and DSCAM/nectin adhesion confusables.

qualifier: alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation with neurometabolic disease defects
name: Fatty acid alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation and neurometabolic disease
rationale: Members are fatty acid alpha/beta/omega oxidation plus inherited defects (ALD, spastic paraplegias, CTX), distinguishing it from peroxisome biogenesis/lipid synthesis and bile acid confusables.

qualifier: Rho and CDC42 subfamilies with formin and IQGAP effectors
name: Rho and CDC42 subfamily GTPase cycles and effectors
rationale: Members are RHOA-D, CDC42, RHOJ/U/V, RHOG and RAC3 GTPase cycles and formin/IQGAP activation, distinguishing it from RND and RAC1/2-WAVE confusables.

name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoform ligand binding and activation
rationale: Members are FGFR1/FGFR2 splice-isoform ligand binding, splicing and activating mutants, distinguishing it from confusables covering downstream FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and FGFR3/4.

name: Glial fate and oligodendrocyte differentiation in CNS myelination
rationale: Members regulate glial fate, oligodendrocyte/astrocyte differentiation and CNS myelin, distinguishing it from Schwann/PNS myelin, axon regeneration and node assembly confusables.

name: MicroRNA biogenesis and RISC assembly
rationale: Members cover miRNA production and RISC loading for silencing, unlike confusables on miRNA turnover and target-specific translational regulation.

name: Glucagon-family and somatostatin GPCR control of growth hormone release
rationale: Members are cAMP-coupled peptide receptor signalling (glucagon-family, somatostatin) and adenylate cyclase activation governing growth hormone secretion, distinguishing it from feeding, GH-receptor and insulin secretion confusables.

name: Locomotor behaviour and glycinergic inhibitory neurotransmission
rationale: Members are motor behaviours (walking, righting, proprioception) plus glycinergic transmission and hyperekplexia, which distinguishes it from behaviour confusables lacking inhibitory glycine signalling.

name: Scavenger receptor-mediated efferocytosis of apoptotic cells
rationale: Members cover recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells and class A/B/F/H scavenger receptor uptake, distinguishing it from foam cell, phospholipid scrambling and microglia confusables.

name: Extracellular matrix degradation of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan
rationale: Members are catabolism of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan and MMP/protease regulation, distinguishing it from collagen synthesis and fibrinolysis confusables.

core: Nucleoside and nucleotide transport and interconversion
qualifier: ADP/ATP phosphotransfer including mitochondrial exchange and creatine
name: Nucleoside transport and ADP/ATP phosphotransfer
rationale: Members combine plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport with nucleotide kinase interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and phosphocreatine, distinguishing it from NAD, NUDT/thiopurine and xenobiotic transport confusables.

name: Stress- and UV-induced premature cellular senescence
rationale: Members regulate senescence and stress/UV responses, with UV response and stress-induced premature senescence distinguishing it from oncogene-induced, SASP and Polycomb chromatin confusables.

name: Cajal body targeting of scaRNA and telomerase RNA
rationale: Members concern localization of scaRNA, telomerase RNA and proteins to Cajal bodies, unlike confusables on telomere extension or snoRNA/rRNA modification.

name: Necroptosis signalling and its viral modulation
rationale: Members are RIPK1-mediated necroptosis and its regulation including pathogen modulation, distinguishing it from caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis and apoptotic execution confusables.

core: Regulation of axon extension during guidance
name: Axon extension guidance and uninjured collateral sprouting
rationale: Members regulate axon extension and chemorepulsion during guidance plus collateral sprouting without injury, distinguishing it from netrin and Sema3A signalling confusables.
